author: Aalokmjoshi
notes: The image shows only a low-angle shot of a weathered basalt rock face with some carved steps or niches against a blue sky. While this rock formation is characteristic of the volcanic basalt found in the Mumbai cave sites (such as Mahakali, Kanheri, or Jogeshwari), there are no unique architectural features, inscriptions, or identifiable cave entrances visible to definitively confirm it as the Mahakali Caves in Andheri East over other local sites.
